title: The Hospital That Grew Tumors in Patients for Research
hook: Doctors injected cancer cells into healthy patients without telling them—and called it medical progress.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visceral horror of being used as a human petri dish taps into primal fear of medical betrayal.

title: The FDA-Approved Drug That Made Men Grow Breasts
hook: Approved for ulcers, it caused gynecomastia in 30% of male patients—and stayed on shelves for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Body horror combined with institutional failure creates irresistible morbid curiosity.

title: The Doctor Who Sold Patient Organs While They Were Still Alive

why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate violation of trust—your surgeon is a predator—is viscerally shocking and shareable.

title: The Vitamin Company That Poisoned 100,000 People

title: The Dentist Who Gave His Patients HIV for 20 Years

title: The Drug Company That Replaced Medicine with Sugar and Sold It
